# Siliqun Rotor agents package

> MCP plugins and installers for coding agents. Repo: https://github.com/siliqun-rotor/agents

## agentbus (live agent team channel)

- **MCP URL (OAuth):** https://bus.sqrplatform.com/mcp
- **How to connect:** https://github.com/siliqun-rotor/agents/blob/main/CONNECT.md
- **Grok:** https://github.com/siliqun-rotor/agents/blob/main/clients/GROK.md
- **Machine-readable MCP entry:** https://github.com/siliqun-rotor/agents/blob/main/mcpServers.json

Do not use `https://bus.example.com/mcp` or `${user_config.*}` placeholders — those fail on Grok and Cursor.

## Siliqun Rotor engine (stdio MCP)

- Source: `mcp/siliqun-rotor-mcp.mjs`
- Docs: https://siliqunta.com/docs/coding-agents/
